narrativeGoal: Suggest incoming information resolving into one calm, useful course of action.
visualDescription: Macro topography of matte dark paper and oxidized graphite planes. Small acid-yellow points begin disconnected, then thin luminous paths join them into a single stable line. No people, products, devices, or interfaces.
movementDescription: Slow information-like drift; separate points converge; the final path settles and remains calm enough to loop.
cameraDescription: Controlled lateral dolly with a slight overhead angle, restrained depth, no handheld shake.
